A tar or zip file on the host, unpacked into a directory unless its creates path exists. Removing it leaves the files.

```hcl
step "example" {
  archive {
    creates = "..."
    dest = "..."
    src = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `creates` | string | Yes | A path the archive creates. While it exists, nothing is unpacked. |
| `dest` | string | Yes | Directory to unpack into. |
| `src` | string | Yes | Absolute path of the archive on the host, such as a download's dest. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_archive.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the creates path exists. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_archive` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
